title: n8n silent-failure monitoring for three workflows
hypothesis: n8n operators and small automation teams will pay for monitoring that detects missing heartbeats, empty or anomalously short runs, and alerts them before silent failures become business failures.
buyer: n8n operators, automation agencies, and small teams running production workflows
offer: NZ$150/month monitoring for up to 3 n8n workflows, with heartbeat and output-anomaly alerts.
smallest_test: Expose one bounded offer to qualified n8n operators and measure replies, checkout activity, and paid subscriptions without changing the fulfillment promise.
evidence_required: Current external demand signal for paid n8n monitoring
Settled payment for any economic claim
Fulfillment evidence showing monitoring was actually activated

fulfillment_contract.buyer_setup: Buyer adds one HTTP heartbeat request to each monitored workflow.
fulfillment_contract.backend: Hosted heartbeat receiver plus scheduled silence/output checks.
fulfillment_contract.manual_work_after_activation: None required for normal monitoring operation.
fulfillment_contract.truth_boundary: Monitoring activation is not revenue proof; revenue requires settled attributable payment and independent fulfillment evidence.

research_provenance.notes: Candidate incorporates the supplied September 2026 n8n Community demand examples and monitoring-tool landscape. External claims must be independently verified before being used as factual marketing copy.
